problem_type: An absent price was encoded as a refusal because the authorization envelope had no way to say "unknown"
symptom: On a clean install every Run-owned paid path refuses to generate: the Agent panel card shows 「暂时算不出价格 / 仍要生成」 and the button always fails, the storyboard plan submission, the external MCP gate, full-auto, rework and continuation all raise generation_pricing_unknown, and the external MCP confirmation silently answers surface:none so the user never even sees a prompt.
direct_cause: assertKnownShotPrice threw GenerationPricingUnavailableError at five call sites (mcpGenerationTools gate_request x2, prepareProductionGenerationAuthorization first-wave/rework/continuation), submissionOutbox threw unknown-cost when costCeiling was null, appIntegrationSpendConfirm added an outer refusal mislabelled generation_quote_changed, and mcpGateConfirmation refused to ask at all when every shot price was unknown.
class_root: The paid authorization envelope encodes an amount and its absence in the same in-band number (jobs[].price.maximum / budget.maximum / budget.ledgerCeiling are all bare `number`). With only one channel, an unknown price can only be written as 0 (a lie that reads as "free") or not written at all (a refusal). Every downstream refusal is a patch over that missing channel, not an independent policy. Same class as 2026-09-07-absent-number-printed-as-zero.
affected_population: Every user on a clean install: 0 of 204 built-in generation models carry a catalog pricing row and no UI can add one, so 100% of Run-owned generations were refused.
Every user who connects their own provider or a local zero-cost runtime (ComfyUI), which likewise has no pricing row.
entry_points: Agent panel spend card 「仍要生成」 (appIntegrationSpendConfirm.confirmPendingSpend)
External MCP nomi_request_generation_gate / nomi_generate (mcpGenerationTools gate_request + mcpGateConfirmation)
Storyboard 「提交执行计划」 and full-auto policy answer (generationTransportAdapters.decideByPolicyAfterDraft)
internal_only_reason: The authorization envelope is a Nomi-internal signed contract shape; no external party reads or writes it. The catalog pricing row it derives from is also ours. There is no published standard for "a spend envelope that can say it does not know the price", so R5.5 has no规范 to align to; the shape reuses this repo own already-shipped precedent (spendGrant unknownRemaining).
invariants: An unknown price is never written or computed as 0 anywhere: envelope, gate, receipt, ledger, card, MCP confirmation text.
budget.maximum / budget.ledgerCeiling / approval.maxSpend cover KNOWN prices only, and the known part of a mixed batch is still capped exactly as before.
Unknown-price jobs never enter a budget comparison: not in checkSealAffordability, not in the batch dispatch accumulator, not in the ledger reserve ceiling check.
budget.unknownJobCount always equals the number of jobs whose price.maximum is null (derived, and rejected if a caller passes a different number).
An unknown-price job may only dispatch because a human (or the full-auto policy) approved the envelope that contains it, never because its amount compared favourably to a ceiling.
The trust downgrade (以后 ¥X 内不再问) stays fail-closed for unknown prices: that gate exists only to name X.
A price of 0 still means free (ComfyUI), and is never conflated with unknown.

door_reduction.why_not: 19 扇门曾各自回答「价格未知能不能花这笔钱」，现在只剩一扇：授权信封的形状（electron/productionRun/productionGenerationAuthorization.ts）。jobs[].price.maximum 变成 number | null 之后，下游每一处求和/比较都会被编译器拦住；budget.unknownJobCount 由 jobs[] 在同一处派生，调用方报一个不一样的数就抛。四条纯粹为「信封写不出未知」而存在的拒绝（五处 assertKnownShotPrice、submissionOutbox 的 unknown-cost、appIntegrationSpendConfirm 的外层重复拒绝、mcpGateConfirmation 的 surface:none）同 commit 删除（P1，不留并行版）——门表因此净减 4 扇。表里剩下的 393 扇是本次改动涉及模块的机器门表（写/读入口），不是「有几处回答这个问题」：那个数是 1。

generality_proof: The unknown axis lives on the envelope every Run-owned paid path must mint, so first wave, rework, continuation, external MCP, full-auto and the Agent panel all inherit it from one place; the e2e tests exercise the panel and full-auto through the real seal/receipt/gate/ledger chain with a loopback vendor, and the unit tests exercise rework and continuation. The renderer spend door (electron/spendGrant.ts assertAndConsumeQuotedSpend) already carried the identical unknownRemaining quota, so both money doors now answer the same question the same way.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: 唯一能说出「这一镜算不出价」的地方：price.maximum 可空 + budget.unknownJobCount 由 jobs[] 派生并校验；所有 Run 侧付费路径都必须经它铸信封。

same_class_entry_points.evidence: 渲染层那条钱闸早就给未知价留了独立名额位 unknownRemaining（既不当 0 也不拒绝），本次不动它——它正是本次搬到 Run 侧的那个形状的现成实现，两条闸从此对同一个问题给同一个答案。
首波、重拍、续批三处 assertKnownShotPrice 同 commit 删除，改为 jobPriceCeiling() 回 null；续批的「已经覆盖了」判据补上未知那根轴。覆盖：electron/productionRun/unknownPriceOpenGate.test.ts 三条。
逐镜与单镜两处抛点删除，maximumCost 改成 number | null 并带 unknownShotCount。覆盖：electron/capabilityCore/mcpGenerationTools.test.ts「opens the gate for an unpriced model」。
删掉 price.known ? amount : 0；未知不进 addLiability、不触发 halt、单列 unknownDispatchCount。覆盖：electron/productionRun/batchScheduleDerivation.test.ts 三条（含 authorized=0 的全未知批次与混合批次仍然 halt 已知那一镜）。
删掉「全批未知 → surface:none」；文案改成三种说法（全未知 / 混合 / 全已知），信任降档那一支保留 fail-closed。覆盖：electron/capabilityCore/mcpGenerationConfirmation.test.ts 三条。
「以后 ¥X 内不再问」给不出 X 就不许问——这条对未知价的拒绝是故意保留的，并改成对 budget.unknownJobCount 的显式判据。覆盖：unknownPriceOpenGate.test.ts 最后一条。

recurrence.reason: Every generation on a clean install hits it, on every path, for every one of the 204 built-in models; and any newly connected provider without a catalog price reproduces it immediately.
same_class_scan: Scanned for `known ? amount : 0` and `?? 0` applied to prices across electron/ and src/: batchScheduleDerivation.priceAmount (the unreachable silent door — fixed), mcpGenerationTools maximumCost fallback (fixed), generationDispatcher maximumCost fallback (fixed), capabilityApplyHandler maximumCost fallback (fixed).

checkSealAffordability and projectMultiShotPreview keep `known ? amount : 0` deliberately — there it means "unknown adds no money", and the unknown itself is reported separately (hasUnknownPrice / unknownShotCount). Comments added so the next reader does not misread them.

Other refuse-on-missing-metadata gates surveyed (listed in the report for the main session to triage): provider capability readiness, cross-field parameter validation, duration/aspect declarations. None changed here.

prevention.invariant: 信封能说出「这一镜算不出价」，而且只有信封决定一次决策覆盖多少笔未知——没有第二处回答这个问题。唯一保留的显式拒绝是信任降档（以后 ¥X 内不再问），那不是这条不变量的例外：它问的是另一个问题（X 是多少），而 X 在未知时根本不存在。
prevention.failure_mode: createProductionGenerationAuthorizationEnvelope throws when a caller states an unknownJobCount that does not match its jobs; every arithmetic use of price.maximum is a compile error until the caller handles null.
prevention.strategy: Give the absent number its own channel at the earliest shared boundary (the signed envelope), then delete every downstream refusal that existed only because that channel was missing.

legacy_paths.rationale: shotPricing 的 assertKnownShotPrice / GenerationPricingUnavailableError（含 generation_pricing_unknown 错误码与 generationTransportAdapters 里对它的分类）、submissionOutbox 的 costCeiling===null→unknown-cost、appIntegrationSpendConfirm 的 unknownShotCount>0→generation_quote_changed（错误码本身是假话）、mcpGateConfirmation 的全未知→surface:none：四条存在的唯一理由都是「信封写不出未知」。信封能写之后它们没有剩余的合法用途，留任何一条都是同一个问题的第二个答案（P1）。

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No framework owns the Nomi spend envelope shape.

migration: Additive only. Envelopes sealed before this change carry no unknownJobCount; the field is derived from jobs[] on construction and is 0 for them (an unknown price could not be sealed before). Ledgers written before this change have numeric reserve amounts; BudgetLedgerSummary.unknownInFlight derives to 0. No stored digest is recomputed for an existing Run, so no in-flight authorization is invalidated.
residual_risks: How many unknown-price jobs a decision covers is bounded by the job set in the envelope, not by a separate quota counter. A defect that minted jobs outside an envelope would not be caught by an amount comparison — but such a job cannot reach dispatch, because dispatch requires a durable job in status authorized which only the envelope creates.

A provider may charge more than the user expected on an unknown-price job; that is the tradeoff the user explicitly accepted on 2026-09-21 (「花多少事后才知道」), surfaced in the approved card copy and in the MCP confirmation text.

Full-auto now runs unknown-price shots without a per-shot prompt (user ruling, overriding the investigation recommendation of "auto only when unknown count is 0"). The ledger records them as unknown so the spend is still auditable after the fact.
